typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Site Location} as string,
		Date as date,
		SNo as decimal(18,0),
		{Source 1 PDU  Rack} as string,
		{Source 1 Availability} as string,
		{Source 2 PDU  Rack} as string,
		{Source 2 Availability} as string,
		{Overall Availability} as string,
		{Rows Connected } as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName,
		Source1Availability2 = toInteger(replace({Source 1 Availability}, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		Source2Availability2 = toInteger(replace({Source 2 Availability}, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100,
		OverallAvailability2 = toInteger(replace({Overall Availability}, toString('%'), toString(''))) / 100) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Source1Availability as double,
		Source2Availability as double,
		UploadDate as string,
		EtlUser as string,
		Source2PDURack as string,
		SNo as integer,
		RowsConnected as string,
		Source1PDU_Rack as string,
		OverallAvailability as double,
		SiteLocation as string,
		FName as string,
		Date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Source1Availability = Source1Availability2,
		Source2Availability = Source2Availability2,
		UploadDate,
		EtlUser,
		Source2PDURack = {Source 2 PDU  Rack},
		SNo,
		RowsConnected = {Rows Connected },
		Source1PDU_Rack = {Source 1 PDU  Rack},
		OverallAvailability = OverallAvailability2,
		SiteLocation = {Site Location},
		FName,
		Date),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
